Participants from enforcement and environmental agencies exchanged views and contacts for future collaborations when prosecuting waste crime. The meeting gathered 24 participants 16 male and 8 female from government agencies in Thailand. Year 3 output 2.1. group event a multiagency dialogue focused on enforcement and port visit in Indonesia 7 November 2023 Unwaste in cooperation with the Directorate General of Customs and Excise organized a joint port visit to Tanjung Priok Port. The visit was conducted by Customs with participation from the Attorney Generals Office Ministry of Trade and Ministry of Environment and Forestry. In the event Tanjung Priok Custom presented the volume and type of waste shipment that went through the port waste inspection procedures and its challenges and past cases and lessons learned. The participants also shared their perspective related to waste trafficking enforcement in Indonesia and discussed strategies to enhance interagency cooperation on handling waste trafficking cases. 27 participants including 16 males 11 females. 26 grom government 1 from others.Year 3 output 2.1. outreach and advocacy presentation of the report series to Indonesian counterparts 6 May 2024 Following the launching of Unwaste report series in Bangkok in April 2024 a presentation event was organized in Jakarta on 6 May 2024 to present the report findings to Indonesian audience. 36 participants including 28 from government 3 private sector and 5 others.Year 3 output 2.1. group event 2nd multi agency consultation for Viet Nam 20 May 2024 The meeting was aimed at updating the delegates on the recent achievements of the project and at presenting the key recommendations of the publication series. The participants also discussed their expectations for the 2nd Joint Regional Meeting and the content that would be shared by the delegation. 6 participants including 4 males 2 females. All government.Year 3 output 2.1 group event 3rd multi agency consultation for Viet Nam 30 May 2024 a third consultation took place on the side of the second Joint Regional Meeting. During the consultation MONRE presented the national legal framework on circular economy and the Draft National Action Plan on Circular Economy. The participants discussed how the draft National Action Plan could fit in the five recommendations highlighted in the Turning the Tide report and how Viet Nam could contribute to the regional effort in combating waste trafficking and promoting the circular economy. The participants formulated identified ways to address the recommendations from the Turning the Tide report through increased cooperation and enforcement at national and international level and by improving data collection and information sharing. 6 participants including 4 males and 2 females. All government.Year 3 output 2.1. group event 3rd NAC meeting for Thaialnd and port visit 26 July 2024 the team held a twopart meeting at the Office of the Laem Chabang Customs port. The first part included the national consultations or the 3rd Waste Trafficking Taskforce for Thailand WTTT which aimed to gather law enforcement agencies environmental protection institutions criminal justice authority and researchers to examine recent policy developments and recommendations for reforms development of new country strategies. On the second half of the day the port visit was hosted and facilitated by Laem Chabang Port Customs Office. The visit provided an opportunity for relevant authorities to exchange perspectives and strengthen collaborations between relevant Thai governmental agencies. 31 participants including 18 males and 13 females. 24 government 5 others 2 academia.

title.narrative: Op: 1.1: Concise quarterly bulletins on waste trafficking trends and developments, including those pertaining to the impact of COVID19, as well as on the latest on policy developments, are disseminated to Southeast Asian governments and EU stakeholders

description.narrative: YEAR 1Output 1.1: 1 quarterly bulletins: The first Unwaste Trendspotting Alert (Bulletin n.1 July 2022) was developed by the UNITAR SCYCLE team, in cooperation with UNODC, and published on 28 July 2022. This first bulletin provides an overview on the main waste flows addressing the four focus countries Malaysia, Indonesia, Thailand and Viet Nam as well as the ASEAN region.YEAR 2Output 1.1: 4 quarterly bulletins: On 31 October 2022, the second bulletin was published and distributed to international and national stakeholders. This bulletin focuses on ewaste and includes interviews and case studies. The third Unwaste Trendspotting Alert was published at the end of January 2023. It provides a global overview of the plastic issue, and an indepth analysis of the plastic waste flows from the EU to the ASEAN region. The fourth bulletin (Unwaste Trendspotting Alert) was published at the end of Q3 and provides an analysis on paper waste flows. The fifth bulletin was published at the end of Q4 and provides an analysis on metal waste flows.YEAR 3 Output 1.1.: 1 quarterly bulletin: the sixth quarterly bulletin was published in November 2023 and was dedicated to hazardous wastes.YEAR 4Output 1.1: 2 quarterly bulletins: the seventh quarterly bulletin was published in December 2024 and focused on clinical waste. The eighth and final quarterly bulletin was published in April 2025 and focused on textile waste.
